tagline.zh: 同视觉重量 ≠ 同几何尺寸:圆形键程 Ø20 比方形 18×18 光学放大 2dp(约 +11%),不对称图形允许小幅光学偏心;Material opsz 轴把补偿参数化。
tagline.en: Equal visual weight ≠ equal geometry: the circle keyline Ø20 optically overshoots the 18×18 square by 2dp (~+11%); asymmetric shapes earn a small optical off-center shift; Material's opsz axis parameterizes the compensation.

origin.zh: 「圆溢出方」是 Material 官方栅格的硬数值:方形键程 18×18、圆形键程直径 20——同视觉重量下圆要画得比方大约 11%(20/18)(out/design-study/07-icons.md §2/§3.1);Lucide 贡献规范把「几何居中不等于看着居中」写成规则:不对称图形允许小幅偏离几何中心(07 §3.2);Material Symbols 的 opsz 轴(20–48,默认 24)随尺寸自动调笔画粗细(07 §1.5/§3.1)。
origin.en: "Circle overshoots square" is a hard number in Material's official grid: square keyline 18×18, circle keyline Ø20 — at equal visual weight the circle must be drawn ~11% larger (20/18) (out/design-study/07-icons.md §2/§3.1); Lucide's contribution spec codifies that geometric centering does not always look centered and allows asymmetric shapes to sit slightly off center (07 §3.2); Material Symbols' opsz axis (20–48, default 24) tunes stroke thickness automatically as size changes (07 §1.5/§3.1).

effect.zh: 渲染边长(px)。默认 24 = Material Symbols opsz 轴官方默认值(README:"The default is 24",07 §1.5);opsz 轴量程 20–48,且仅 20px 与 24px 版本做了完美像素栅格对齐。demo 用恒定 2px 绝对线宽(non-scaling-stroke)示意 opsz 方向——放大后线条相对变细、缩小后相对变粗;opsz 的官方补偿曲线未公开,demo 为方向示意而非曲线复刻。
effect.en: Rendered edge length (px). Default 24 = the official default of Material Symbols' opsz axis (README: "The default is 24", 07 §1.5); the axis spans 20–48, and only the 20px and 24px versions achieve perfect pixel-grid alignment. The demo keeps a constant 2px absolute stroke (non-scaling-stroke) to indicate the opsz direction — relatively thinner when enlarged, thicker when shrunk; the official opsz compensation curve is unpublished, so the demo indicates direction rather than replicating the curve.

effect.zh: 光学补偿开关。on = 圆形键程按官方规则放大到 Ø20(方形 18×18,+11.1%),不对称三角形按 Lucide 规则做小幅光学偏心;off = 圆与方同尺寸 Ø18 的纯几何对照——并排模糊观察,圆会明显显轻(07 §2/§3.1/§3.2)。三角形偏移量 demo 取 0.5px(24 网格内),Lucide 只写 "may be moved slightly off center" 未给数值,0.5px 为演示取值(未证实为官方数)。
effect.en: Optical compensation switch. On = the circle keyline grows to the official Ø20 (square 18×18, +11.1%) and the asymmetric triangle takes a small optical off-center shift per Lucide's rule; off = a purely geometric control with circle and square both at Ø18 — blur them side by side and the circle clearly reads lighter (07 §2/§3.1/§3.2). The triangle's demo shift is 0.5px (in the 24 grid); Lucide only says "may be moved slightly off center" without a number, so 0.5px is a demo value (unverified as official).

note.zh: 演示用到的 SVG 能力(viewBox 缩放、vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke、CSS filter: blur)全主流浏览器支持;non-scaling-stroke 为 SVG 1.1/2 标准属性。Material Symbols 的 opsz 轴本身是变量字体能力,依赖可变字体加载(见 browserSupport 基线)。
note.en: The SVG capabilities used here (viewBox scaling, vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke, CSS filter: blur) are supported in all mainstream browsers; non-scaling-stroke is standard SVG. Material Symbols' opsz axis itself is a variable-font capability, contingent on variable font loading.

fallback.zh: 无需回退:光学缩放是绘制准则,交付物是普通 SVG。若做 Material Symbols 变量字体路线,字体加载失败时退回静态 wght 400 实例(默认即 24px 光学设计),不会丢失图形。
fallback.en: No fallback needed: optical sizing is a drawing discipline and the deliverable is plain SVG. On the Material Symbols variable-font route, a failed font load falls back to the static wght 400 instance (optically designed at 24) without losing the glyph.

use.zh: 自绘图标的验收:方形贴 18×18、圆形贴 Ø20、不对称元素允许 0.5px 级偏心(07 §2/§3.2)
use.en: Acceptance for self-drawn icons: squares on 18×18, circles on Ø20, asymmetric elements allowed a ~0.5px optical shift (07 §2/§3.2)

use.zh: 同一行混合圆/方/三角元素时消除「圆显轻、三角显偏」的观感
use.en: Removing the 'circle reads lighter, triangle reads off' impression when mixing circle/square/triangle in one row

use.zh: 图标从 24px 主网格扩展到 16/32/48px 渲染档时核对笔画粗细方向(opsz 思路,07 §3.1)
use.en: Checking stroke-thickness direction when a 24 master extends to 16/32/48px render tiers (opsz thinking, 07 §3.1)

avoid.zh: 把光学偏移当万能微调旋钮:偏移只服务「看着居中」,像素栅格让位但不能破坏形状识别(Lucide:pixel alignment should support the icon,07 §3.2)
avoid.en: Treating optical offsets as a universal nudge knob: they only serve perceived centering — the pixel grid yields but must not hurt shape recognition (Lucide: pixel alignment should support the icon, 07 §3.2)

avoid.zh: 只有圆做了补偿、方与三角不补偿的半套方案——行内重量反而更乱
avoid.en: A half-applied scheme where only circles compensate — inline weight consistency gets worse, not better

avoid.zh: 小尺寸(<16px)仍坚持严格像素对齐而牺牲流畅曲线——官方明确栅格对齐是手段不是目的(07 §3.2)
avoid.en: Insisting on strict pixel alignment at tiny sizes (<16px) at the cost of smooth curves — the spec says alignment supports the icon, not the reverse (07 §3.2)

a11y.zh: 光学补偿不改变对比度义务:图形对象与邻接底色仍需 ≥3:1(WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11)。放大检查(opsz 方向)会让细线在小尺寸相对变粗、更易达标;反之放大到大尺寸时保持恒定 2px 绝对线宽会让线条相对变细,注意别跌破阈值(07 §3.1/§3.3/§4.3)。
a11y.en: Optical compensation does not change contrast obligations: graphical objects still need ≥3:1 against adjacent colors (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11). opsz-direction thinning helps small sizes (relatively thicker strokes) but a constant 2px absolute stroke at large sizes gets relatively thinner — watch the threshold (07 §3.1/§3.3/§4.3).

goal.zh: 在一行内绘制方、圆、三角三个 24 网格图形:方形键程 18×18、圆形键程 Ø20(+11.1% 光学放大)、三角形做 0.5px 光学偏心,并排模糊后三者灰度观感一致。
goal.en: Draw square, circle and triangle on the 24 grid in one row: square keyline 18×18, circle keyline Ø20 (+11.1% optical overshoot), triangle with a 0.5px optical shift — blurred together, all three read the same weight.

acceptance.zh: 方形元素严格贴 18×18 键程;圆形元素贴 Ø20 键程(圆比方大 2dp,官方值)
acceptance.en: Square elements sit exactly on the 18×18 keyline; circles on the Ø20 keyline (circle 2dp larger than square, official)

acceptance.zh: 对称元素保持几何居中;不对称元素允许 ≤1px 级光学偏移并说明理由
acceptance.en: Symmetric elements stay geometrically centered; asymmetric ones may shift ≤1px with a stated reason

acceptance.zh: 全部 X/Y 坐标为整数;光学偏移是唯一允许的小数,且不超过 0.5 单位
acceptance.en: All X/Y coordinates are integers; optical offsets are the only sanctioned fraction, never above 0.5 units

acceptance.zh: 验收用模糊法:与 circle/square 参考并排整体模糊,灰度不得明显失衡(Lucide 原版技法)
acceptance.en: Verify with the blur test: blur the row beside a circle/square reference; grayscale balance must hold (Lucide's own technique)

acceptance.zh: 提供渲染档位说明:大尺寸渲染线相对变细是 opsz 方向,不是绘制错误
acceptance.en: Document render tiers: relatively thinner strokes at larger sizes are the opsz direction, not a drawing bug
